notes: Cheats on every core that has them, confirmed by the MiSTer: a switch drives the MiSTer menu and the app reads the MiSTer's own log (debug=2 in MiSTer.ini, set by the installer) to prove the cheat went on. The menu layout comes from the running core build. Verified on N64, NES, PSX, SNES, Genesis, Game Boy, GBA, Master System, TurboGrafx-16 and Lynx. Also: PC Engine and other systems whose folder name differs from the core file now launch from the Library; cheat lists follow the MiSTer's own file (N64 and NES CRCs); the Install page rendered blank on a fresh start; Settings > Logs shows the MiSTer's log.
